name: blockchainlab-sdk
summary: Typed TypeScript and Python clients for the Blockchain Lab Open Data API: 20 nightly-rebuilt blockchain datasets (chains, RPC health, DeFi TVL, stablecoins, yields, L2 metrics, hacks, OFAC addresses, EIPs/ERCs/BIPs, grants, hackathons).

inputs.name: filters
inputs.description: symbol, chainId, chain, since, minUsd, limit, address

outputs.name: typed rows
outputs.description: from the API envelope's data array

outputs.name: envelope
outputs.description: dataset, schema_version, generated_at, source, count, data

compatible_with.how: the data source; the SDK types are generated from its JSON Schemas (scripts/gen.py)
same data exposed as MCP tools for AI agents; use the SDK in app code, the MCP server in agent clients
pick a healthy RPC (healthyRpcs) and screen wallets (isSanctioned) in a dApp front end around the contracts
add SDK calls as Grok tools in a composed chat app (see Build with Blocks recipe 2)
the hub pages read the same API

tests.command: npm test && (cd python && python -m unittest -v tests/test_live.py)
